### 6.7 Second-site check

We also ran TERN, without re-tuning, on a second site outside the estate: the Holmrigg College campus (12 AHUs, 60 labelled fault episodes over seven months). It detected 39 of the 60 episodes, with an F1 of 0.72 and a median detection delay of 47 minutes.
